leads.title: Mediar and Ono Pharmaceutical to develop fibro-inflammatory treatments
leads.description: Mediar Therapeutics has announced a collaboration and option agreement with Ono Pharmaceutical to develop treatments for fibro-inflammatory diseases.

leads.title: Takeda nets first-in-class advantage on narcolepsy drug’s FDA go-ahead
leads.description: GlobalData previously flagged Orzeyful’s approval in narcolepsy as a key Q3 catalyst for pharma due to the drug’s ‘transformative’ potential.

leads.title: Alteogen signs $365m Hybrozyme licensing deal with pharma company
leads.description: Alteogen has signed an exclusive licensing deal worth up to $365m with a global pharmaceutical company, granting worldwide rights to develop and commercialise a subcutaneous biologic product using its Hybrozyme technology.
